classification: independent historical verification; no new parameter trials

checks.name: ml4t-fetch-data
checks.reason: Verify frozen source partitions and date range.

checks.name: ml4t-validate-data
checks.reason: Audit one-minute market data before ATR and fill review.
checks.invariant: No invalid OHLC, duplicate timestamps, null values, or unreported gaps.
checks.verification: Phase 2 quality artifact records zero duplicate timestamps, null OHLC, invalid OHLC, and non-finite OHLC; gaps and incomplete 30-minute bins are counted.

checks.verification: America/Chicago session assignment inspected; DST unit test passes. Six entry fills still cross annual shard boundaries after source gaps.

checks.reason: Check ATR20 construction and feature release.
checks.invariant: ATR uses complete sorted bars and is released only after bar completion.
checks.verification: Runner uses installed ml4t.engineer ATR; completion/release timestamps and warmup are checked by focused tests.

checks.name: ml4t-lookahead-bias
checks.reason: Check signal availability versus next-minute native order eligibility.
checks.invariant: Only completed 30-minute data is available before entry; no future bar is used.
checks.verification: As-of release tests pass; the frozen method releases ATR on its completed bar's final minute and uses NEXT_BAR execution.

checks.name: ml4t-point-in-time
checks.reason: Review temporal joins and feature availability.
checks.invariant: Features join backward from known availability time.
checks.verification: Polars join_asof uses backward strategy on feature_available_at; all 5,462 corrected B0 entries receive ATR context.

checks.name: ml4t-polars-patterns
checks.reason: Review sorted rolling bars, as-of joins, and artifact aggregation.
checks.invariant: Time order is explicit; nearest feature joins use backward as-of semantics.
checks.verification: Runner sorts source timestamps and feature release timestamps; Phase 3 uses join_asof(strategy='backward').

checks.reason: Verify native execution, fills, and trade accounting.
checks.invariant: Use the installed Engine and reconcile orders, fills, trades, and equity.

checks.name: ml4t-cost-model
checks.reason: Check commission and slippage per contract per fill.
checks.invariant: Every filled contract side pays frozen cost; cost assumptions and missing spread are explicit.
checks.verification: $1.25 per MNQ contract per fill and 0.25-point adverse slippage reconcile to fills. BID-only data omits spread; costs are not broker verified.

checks.name: ml4t-position-sizing
checks.reason: Check integer quantity, tick-rounded stop distance, and nominal risk.
checks.invariant: Quantity follows the frozen integer risk formula and the actual placed stop is measured from the actual fill.
checks.verification: Planned quantity matches floor(1000/(2*stop_points)); outward tick rounding causes actual stop risk above $1,000 on 137 trades, maximum $1,036.45.

checks.reason: Compare costed and zero-cost paths without false cost attribution.

checks.verification: Direct commissions plus slippage are $450,541; net-path delta is $451,152.82, leaving $611.82 unexplained by direct costs because paths diverge. No spread or impact evidence exists.

checks.invariant: Report cash and tail risk, not only aggregate PnL.
checks.verification: Worst trade, losses below -$1,000, actual stop-risk overshoot, and worst daily equity change are reported. Daily equity risk is marked contaminated by out-of-year fills.

checks.reason: Control selection bias and honor the no-new-variants instruction.
checks.invariant: Do not imply robustness from a single frozen parameter choice; preserve the trial count.
